title: Conditional M320 HE projectile-transit capture feasibility
question: Would an observed 20 m projectile-transit interval separate the serialized M320 Shot.InitialSpeed.z value from the distinct projectile InitialSpeed value under explicit idealized assumptions?

inputs.sourceBasis: M320 PrimaryFire_M320 Shot.InitialSpeed.z raw value 63 and PB_NS_M320HE InitialSpeed raw value 250. These are conditional numerical hypotheses only; serialized units and native precedence are not established.
inputs.gravityUse: Vertical displacement sensitivity only; no projectile trajectory or native physics claim.

captureCandidate: Use the ordinary M4A1 M320 HE configuration only if the menu offers it; document the exact weapon, attachment, class, specialization and active traits.
Measure 20 m, keep the shooter stationary, identify the live build, and verify recording FPS.

Frame the direct muzzle-launch event and projectile transit endpoint or first collision. Record bounded frame uncertainty for both events; the calculated intervals assume plus/minus 2 frames per timing at 60 fps.
Do not use explosion time as projectile arrival; arming or fuse delay could add an unrelated interval.
These are candidate conditions only. The arithmetic does not promise that either event can be observed or framed in the live game.
limits: Arithmetic only; no live capture or measurement was made.
No native speed units, active value, launch precedence, drag, effective trajectory, or gameplay behavior is established.
No site values were reviewed or changed.
